title: Feature Request: UI Move "Stop Sensor" to something more inconvenient
symptom: The "stop sensor" button is prominently placed on the main menu, and user error can cause confusion between "stop sensor" and "snooze alert", especially for users with low blood sugar at 3am who just want to make the noise stop. This can lead to accidentally stopping an expensive sensor early.
evidence_quote: The "stop sensor" button is prominently placed on the main menu. User error can cause the "stop sensor" function and "snooze alert" function to be confused -- especially by someone with low blood sugar at 3am who just wants to make the noise stop and clicks through.
